**[P2] Reject factory classes with unbound instance methods**

Checking only `callable(getattr(...))` accepts `plugins=[MyFactory]` when `MyFactory.create_plugin` is a normal instance method. The later call supplies only `info`, so Python binds it as `self` and reports the missing argument; that error is swallowed on every invocation and instrumentation silently never runs. Validate that the selected member can be called with one argument, or reject class objects unless `create_plugin` is a class/static method, while retaining the documented classmethod support. Cover both explicit and entry-point registrations.
